entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. For questions about an existing order or to make a return, please press one.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return. I've been a loyal customer for years and I'm just feeling a bit stuck.
I can certainly look into that for you. To pull up your account, could I please have your order number?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Ride Helmet. It looks like that was delivered about 69 days ago. To understand how I can best help, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the helmet?

Oh, no, it's not broken. It's just... the color. On the website, it looked like a really bright red, but in person, it's much darker. It doesn't match my bike at all. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out. I was really counting on getting this money back.

I completely understand. Getting the right color is important, and you want to feel good in your gear. After all, the main purpose of a helmet is safety, and feeling confident in your equipment is part of that. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I have good news. Because it's a standard item and you're within our 10-day return window, I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! Really? That's such a relief. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you so much, Sarah.

Of course, I'm happy to help! I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. You can just print that, attach it to the original shipping box, and drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be issued once we receive the item.
That's perfect. You've made my day. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
